name: blazing_buffalo
description: Self-Learning Mistake System for Agent Ecosystem - Capture, analyze, prevent, and learn from agent mistakes automatically

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Security fixes, cold start data mining, baseline metrics

phases.name: Core Detection
phases.description: Mistake detector hook, correction verifier, Neo4j/Qdrant schemas

phases.name: Analysis Pipeline
phases.description: Dynamic taxonomy, attribution scoring, RCA pipeline with Ralph integration

phases.name: Prevention System
phases.description: Playbook generator, conflict detector, circuit breaker, lifecycle manager

phases.name: Integration
phases.description: REST API endpoints, Prometheus metrics, playbook executor

phases.name: Hardening
phases.description: Dashboard UI, alerting, documentation, load testing

tasks.title: Security audit and fix kg-update.sh shell injection
tasks.description: Review line 283 of kg-update.sh for shell injection vulnerability. Apply proper quoting and input validation. Create lib/validators.py for reusable validation.

tasks.title: Cold start mining - extract corrections from historical sessions
tasks.description: Create secured mining script using find -print0 | xargs -0 pattern. Extract user corrections from ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl files. Target: 100+ corrections.

tasks.title: Build HNSW index on Qdrant engineer-team-knowledge collection
tasks.description: Configure and build HNSW index with m=32, ef_construct=256. Verify search performance improves to <50ms.

tasks.title: Collect baseline metrics before implementation
tasks.description: Document current error rates, agent task durations, retry frequencies. Create baseline-report.json for comparison after implementation.

tasks.title: Create Neo4j Mistake node schema and migration
tasks.description: Implement Mistake node with id, category, description, session_id, agent_id, file_path, line_number, detection_method, severity, resolution_status, timestamp, context_hash. Create relationships: OCCURRED_IN, MADE_BY, SIMILAR_TO, RESOLVED_BY, PREVENTED_BY.

tasks.title: Create Qdrant mistakes collection for embeddings
tasks.description: Create new collection 'mistakes' with vector_size=384, distance=Cosine, HNSW config. Payload schema for mistake metadata.

tasks.title: Implement mistake_detector.py PostToolUse hook
tasks.description: Create hook that detects mistakes from: user corrections (NLP), tool errors (exit code), test failures, type checker errors, lint errors. Emit events to KG.

tasks.title: Implement correction_verifier.py for false positive prevention
tasks.description: Create verifier that checks: syntax validity, semantic consistency, test results, user history. Threshold 0.6 for uncertain corrections requiring clarification.

tasks.title: Implement dynamic_taxonomy.py with emergent clustering
tasks.description: Create DynamicTaxonomy class with embedding-based clustering. Threshold 0.8 for cluster membership. Emit events on new category discovery. Support hierarchical suggestion.

tasks.title: Implement attribution.py for multi-agent mistake scoring
tasks.description: Create MistakeAttribution class that traces errors through workflows. Score contribution per agent with roles: originator, propagator, detector. Store as CONTRIBUTED_BY relationship.

tasks.title: Implement mistake_rca.py Root Cause Analysis pipeline
tasks.description: Create MistakeRCA class with: context extraction, similar mistake lookup (top_k=5), pattern detection, root cause classification, prevention rule generation. Integrate with Ralph loop for multi-model analysis.

tasks.title: Implement playbook_generator.py with template system
tasks.description: Create PlaybookGenerator that produces YAML playbooks from resolved mistakes. Use Jinja2 with autoescape for security. Include: trigger patterns, detection rules, resolution steps, success tracking.

tasks.title: Implement conflict_detector.py for oscillation prevention
tasks.description: Create PlaybookConflictDetector that analyzes solution effects and finds conflicting playbooks. Return ConflictReport with recommendation for manual review when conflicts detected.

tasks.title: Implement circuit_breaker.py for playbook reliability
tasks.description: Create PlaybookCircuitBreaker with 3 states: closed, open, half_open. Config: failure_threshold=3, recovery_timeout=300s. Emit alerts on circuit open.

tasks.title: Implement playbook_lifecycle.py for decay and revalidation
tasks.description: Create lifecycle manager with aging rules: 30d reduce confidence, 90d require revalidation, 180d archive if unused. Trigger revalidation when failure_rate > 0.3.

tasks.title: Implement playbook_executor.py with timeout tiers
tasks.description: Create PlaybookExecutor with 5 timeout tiers: instant(5s), fast(30s), standard(120s), long(600s), background(async). Support step-level checkpointing.

tasks.title: Implement playbook_resolver.py for per-project customization
tasks.description: Create 3-layer resolver: global → project-type → local. Support extends syntax for playbook inheritance. Merge strategy: later overrides earlier.

tasks.title: Create REST API endpoints for mistake data
tasks.description: Implement FastAPI routes: GET /mistakes, POST /mistakes, GET /mistakes/{id}, GET /playbooks, POST /playbooks/execute. Include OpenAPI docs.

tasks.title: Add Prometheus metrics for observability
tasks.description: Create metrics: mistakes_detected_total, playbook_executions_total, playbook_success_rate, circuit_breaker_state, rca_latency_seconds. Export at /metrics.

tasks.title: Implement effectiveness_tracker.py for playbook scoring
tasks.description: Create EffectivenessTracker with per-project-type scoring. Metrics: success_rate, avg_resolution_time, user_satisfaction, regression_rate. Support A/B testing for prompt variants.

tasks.title: Implement rate_limiter.py for RCA pipeline
tasks.description: Create RCARateLimiter with limits: 10/min, 100/hr, 500/day, 3 concurrent. Emit warnings on limit hit.

tasks.title: Implement audit_logger.py for compliance
tasks.description: Create MistakeAuditLogger for access tracking. Log: read, write, delete, export events. 1-year retention, encryption at rest. Alert on sensitive access.

tasks.title: Create disaster recovery procedures
tasks.description: Implement daily backups for Neo4j, Qdrant, local events. Define RPO=24h, RTO=2h. Create restore scripts and verification.

tasks.title: Build mistake dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create web dashboard showing: recent mistakes, playbook effectiveness, circuit breaker status, trend graphs. Use existing design system.

tasks.title: Create alerting rules for operational issues
tasks.description: Define alerts: circuit_breaker_open, high_false_positive_rate, rca_latency_high, backup_failed. Configure PagerDuty/Slack integration.

tasks.title: Write comprehensive documentation
tasks.description: Create user guide, API docs, architecture diagrams, troubleshooting guide. Add to MkDocs site.

tasks.title: Perform load testing and optimization
tasks.description: Load test: 100 concurrent mistakes, 1000 playbook executions. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize for <100ms p99 latency.
